fluff.overview: Word of Blake Militia infantry served as the backbone of Protectorate garrison forces across dozens of conquered worlds, providing the manpower for territorial control that the Militia's BattleMech and armor assets could not sustain alone. Motorized Level I formations used light vehicles for rapid movement between garrison posts, providing the speed needed to respond to civil unrest or insurgent attacks faster than foot infantry could march. Their mobility made them a preferred choice for patrol duties across the Word's Protectorate holdings. Armed with standard ballistic assault rifles, the most common and affordable infantry weapon in the Inner Sphere, these troops deliver reliable short-range firepower and can be equipped and resupplied from almost any garrison stockpile.
